title: ThreadLocal::remove performance impacts
body:
https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/blob/04d4d65fb47a3db4cd8a320795a397f1ae678173/src/main/java/io/vertx/core/net/impl/pool/CombinerExecutor.java#L60 introduced to solve https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/issues/4583 is not performant (for our use cases), see
https://github.com/smallrye/smallrye-context-propagation/issues/424#issuecomment-1600718621

A different mechanism or just using `FastThreadLocal`'s (to ve verified if they have the same impact) would solve it.
